Class ResourceHydroSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourceHydroSectionBuilder
public class ResourceHydroSectionBuilder extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller and Section Builder for Hydrographic Domains, River Networks, and Freshwater Aquifers.

Extracted from ResourceDistributionPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Encapsulates the hydrological modeling layer:

  • Surface Runoff invalid input: '&' Fluvial Networks: Watershed flow accumulation, Strahler stream order, and channel slope.
  • Groundwater invalid input: '&' Subsurface Aquifers: Piezometric head volume (\(\times 10^3\ \mathrm{km}^3\)) and hydraulic recharge.
  • Empirical GIS Ingestion: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) SWBD / USGS HydroSHEDS raster ingestion.
